tickets <- tibble(id = 1,
  body = "Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight, a company in Chicago.")
# one row in, one row out per name
tickets |>
  mutate(names = tt_recognize(body,
    kinds = c("person", "organization", "place"),
    relations = list(works_for = c("person", "organization"),
                     based_in = c("organization", "place")))) |>
  tidyr::unnest(names)
#   id text              kind         relations
# 1  1 Maria Chen        person       works_for 1 → 2
# 2  1 Northwind Freight organization based_in 2 → 3
# 3  1 Chicago           place
